display_long_description:
PUNCH. SMASH. SCORE. REPEAT.
Step into a colorful arcade arena where fruit comes flying and your fists are the only weapons you need.
Fruit Smash: Punch Challenge is a fast-paced VR arcade game built around reflexes, satisfying punches, combos and high-score chasing. Punch incoming fruit, smash targets, avoid dangerous bombs and keep your combo alive for as long as possible.
🥊 SATISFYING PUNCHING
Use both hands to punch, smash and juggle flying fruit with responsive physics and colorful impact effects.
🍉 FRUIT-SMASHING ARCADE ACTION
Targets arrive quickly from different directions. React fast, choose your punches and don't let fruit escape.
💣 DODGE THE BOMBS
Not everything should be punched. Spot dangerous objects, react quickly and protect your combo.
⚡ FRENZY MODE
Build a powerful combo to activate Frenzy Mode and unleash a rush of fruit for massive scoring opportunities.
🏆 CHASE HIGH SCORES
Chain hits, build multipliers and compete for better scores with quick rounds designed for repeat play.
Simple controls. Fast reactions. Big combos.
How high can you score?
